Task: Federated Login Flow

Write code that handles the callback and exchanges an authorization code for tokens using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Google Identity Platform OIDC:
  Service: Google Identity Platform
  SDK: REST / firebase-admin
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: signInWithIdp, OIDC provider config
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/identity-platform/docs/web/oidc

Option 2 — Alibaba Cloud IDaaS EIAM OIDC:
  Service: IDaaS EIAM OIDC
  SDK: OIDC REST
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_IDAAS_ISSUER, ALIBABA_IDAAS_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/idaas/eiam/developer-reference/integrate-sso-with-oidc

Option 3 — IBM App ID Federation:
  Service: IBM Cloud App ID federation
  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: IBM_APPID_CLIENT_ID, IBM_APPID_CLIENT_SECRET
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/appid?topic=appid-enterprise

Option 4 — Auth0:
  Service: Auth0 Authentication API
  SDK: auth0-python / OIDC
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: authorize, oauth/token, userinfo
  Setup hints: AUTH0_DOMAIN, AUTH0_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://auth0.com/docs/api/authentication

Option 5 — Cognito Hosted UI Federation:
  Service: Amazon Cognito federation
  SDK: boto3 + OIDC
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: COGNITO_DOMAIN, COGNITO_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pools-identity-provider.html

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import base64
import hashlib
import hmac
import json
import os
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlencode, urljoin

import requests


class FederatedLoginError(Exception):
    pass


class Auth0FederatedLoginCallbackHandler:
    """
    Handles an OAuth2/OIDC callback and exchanges an authorization code for tokens
    using Auth0's Authentication API.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        domain: Optional[str] = None,
        client_id: Optional[str] = None,
        client_secret: Optional[str] = None,
        redirect_uri: Optional[str] = None,
        audience: Optional[str] = None,
        scope: str = "openid profile email offline_access",
        session_state: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.domain = domain or os.environ.get("AUTH0_DOMAIN")
        self.client_id = client_id or os.environ.get("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID")
        self.client_secret = client_secret or os.environ.get("AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET")
        self.redirect_uri = redirect_uri or os.environ.get("AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI")
        self.audience = audience or os.environ.get("AUTH0_AUDIENCE")
        self.scope = scope
        self.session_state = session_state if session_state is not None else {}

        if not self.domain:
            raise FederatedLoginError("AUTH0_DOMAIN is required")
        if not self.client_id:
            raise FederatedLoginError("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID is required")
        if not self.client_secret:
            raise FederatedLoginError("AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET is required")
        if not self.redirect_uri:
            raise FederatedLoginError("AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI is required")

        self.issuer = f"https://{self.domain}/"
        self.token_endpoint = f"https://{self.domain}/oauth/token"
        self.userinfo_endpoint = f"https://{self.domain}/userinfo"
        self.authorize_endpoint = f"https://{self.domain}/authorize"

    def build_authorize_url(self, state: str, nonce: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
        params = {
            "response_type": "code",
            "client_id": self.client_id,
            "redirect_uri": self.redirect_uri,
            "scope": self.scope,
            "state": state,
        }
        if nonce:
            params["nonce"] = nonce
        if self.audience:
            params["audience"] = self.audience
        return f"{self.authorize_endpoint}?{urlencode(params)}"

    def handle_callback(self, query_string: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        params = parse_qs(query_string, keep_blank_values=True)

        if "error" in params:
            error = params.get("error", ["unknown_error"])[0]
            description = params.get("error_description", [""])[0]
            raise FederatedLoginError(f"Authorization failed: {error} {description}".strip())

        code = params.get("code", [None])[0]
        if not code:
            raise FederatedLoginError("Missing authorization code in callback")

        returned_state = params.get("state", [None])[0]
        expected_state = self.session_state.get("oauth_state")
        if expected_state is not None and returned_state != expected_state:
            raise FederatedLoginError("Invalid state parameter")

        tokens = self.exchange_code_for_tokens(code)
        userinfo = self.fetch_userinfo(tokens.get("access_token"))

        result = {
            "tokens": tokens,
            "userinfo": userinfo,
        }

        if "id_token" in tokens:
            result["id_token_valid_hint"] = self._compute_simple_token_hint(tokens["id_token"])

        self.session_state["oauth_tokens"] = tokens
        self.session_state["oauth_userinfo"] = userinfo
        return result

    def exchange_code_for_tokens(self, code: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        payload = {
            "grant_type": "authorization_code",
            "client_id": self.client_id,
            "client_secret": self.client_secret,
            "code": code,
            "redirect_uri": self.redirect_uri,
        }
        if self.audience:
            payload["audience"] = self.audience

        resp = requests.post(
            self.token_endpoint,
            json=payload,
            headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
            timeout=20,
        )
        if resp.status_code >= 400:
            raise FederatedLoginError(f"Token exchange failed: {resp.status_code} {resp.text}")

        data = resp.json()
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            raise FederatedLoginError("Invalid token response")

        required = ["access_token", "token_type"]
        for key in required:
            if key not in data:
                raise FederatedLoginError(f"Missing '{key}' in token response")

        return data

    def fetch_userinfo(self, access_token: Optional[str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        if not access_token:
            return {}

        resp = requests.get(
            self.userinfo_endpoint,
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {access_token}"},
            timeout=20,
        )
        if resp.status_code >= 400:
            raise FederatedLoginError(f"Userinfo request failed: {resp.status_code} {resp.text}")

        data = resp.json()
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            raise FederatedLoginError("Invalid userinfo response")
        return data

    def _compute_simple_token_hint(self, token: str) -> str:
        digest = hashlib.sha256(token.encode("utf-8")).digest()
        return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(digest[:12]).decode("ascii").rstrip("=")


def handle_federated_login_callback(
    query_string: str,
    session_state: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    domain: Optional[str] = None,
    client_id: Optional[str] = None,
    client_secret: Optional[str] = None,
    redirect_uri: Optional[str] = None,
    audience: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    handler = Auth0FederatedLoginCallbackHandler(
        domain=domain,
        client_id=client_id,
        client_secret=client_secret,
        redirect_uri=redirect_uri,
        audience=audience,
        session_state=session_state,
    )
    return handler.handle_callback(query_string)
